criticalAnswer.currentDraftProblem: Older stuck-hatch accident contained upper-arm grip/shoulder proximity only; it NEVER created uncertainty over whether Babloo saw anything intimate. User was correct to question that.
criticalAnswer.newAccidentMechanics: At the offsite badminton-court car, Meenakshi reaches into the open boot for papers. Her dupatta catches near the hatch edge. As she tries to free it, the supported hatch dips; Babloo steadies it and Meenakshi instinctively catches his upper arm and steps close. The snag moves her dupatta and the line of her kurta briefly. Babloo lifts his gaze once and looks away. Neither a deliberate look nor the precise scope of visibility is asserted.
criticalAnswer.meenakshiUncertainty: Did he notice only the snagged dupatta, the kurta shifting at the neckline, or something more? From her angle she cannot tell and he does not volunteer an answer. Separate from her other question: why did she so readily grab his arm and later remember that contact?
criticalAnswer.bablooUncertainty: Babloo does not know if Meenakshi noticed his brief startled glance or how she interpreted it; his private conclusion remains unrevealed here.
criticalAnswer.whatIsNOTCanon: No definitively seen nudity or explicit anatomical glimpse is established. The uncertainty is intentional and may be resolved only in the later author-controlled conversation.

scenes.title: Society Babloo A — the hatch and unknown glimpse

beats.title: At the car, no magic relocation
beats.action: They reach her car where the Jan1 badminton incident left it. A professional checks why the car would not start. Babloo opens and supports the hatch so Meenakshi can collect hospital papers.
beats.mechanics: The hatch is being manually held; its movement is a separate handling mishap, not a secretly invented total vehicle failure.

beats.title: The dupatta snag and Babloo's reflex
beats.action: Meenakshi's dupatta catches near the hatch edge. As she tries to free it, the hatch dips toward her. Babloo prevents it from closing while she reflexively grips his upper arm and steps close. In that single scramble the drape of her kurta shifts; Babloo briefly looks up and looks away.
beats.physical: A short emergency arm hold, accidental clothing shift, immediate release when stable. No invented deliberate grab or detailed body exposure.
beats.sightline: No spectators within the small working zone; precise visibility to Babloo remains withheld, not misrepresented as definite.
beats.reaction: Meenakshi is startled both by the fabric moving and by her own impulsive reach. Babloo becomes quiet and refocuses on the car.

beats.title: Two doubts, no forced answer
beats.action: Meenakshi straightens her clothing and returns to the practical problem. She cannot tell exactly what Babloo noticed, nor why the small contact stays with her. He does not turn the moment into a repetitive apology or flirty compliment.
beats.memory: She will privately recall the surprise but not assume he definitely saw exposed skin.

beats.title: Professional recovery and travel check
beats.action: Mechanic checks the starter/battery and hatch safety, without an invented definitive diagnosis. PROPOSED branch: car is safely cleared by about 08:20 and Meenakshi leaves for duty. If not cleared, she hires alternate transport and the afternoon four-person car ride must be changed.
beats.dependency: No car seat competition can be planned as a fact unless her car is genuinely driveable.

beats.title: Arrival, change and rounds
beats.action: Meenakshi reaches the hospital on whichever safe transport the morning outcome permits. Avi and Yash are already familiar from Jan1, not new admirers. Hospital work comes first.
beats.reaction: While reviewing files, she briefly remembers Babloo's silence, then returns to patient and team work.

beats.title: Three peers respond differently
beats.action: Avi volunteers for a time-sensitive case summary, Yash quietly checks a numerical discrepancy, and Aditi leads a separate follow-up. Avoid re-running Jan1 farmhouse flirt from its first beat.
beats.reaction: Meenakshi notes different kinds of reliability and attention; no assumed romantic decision from one look.

beats.title: Staff-only teasing, not a reset
beats.action: A brief coffee alcove remark by Avi is met with Meenakshi's confident comeback; Yash offers an understated observation; Aditi is independent rather than a prop. Meenakshi's mood has a privately buoyant edge but she stays professional.

beats.title: Naveen and the annexure
beats.action: Hospital helper Naveen (22) returns with the needed annexure for a genuine administrative reason. He is known from Jan1 work, not a newly introduced society Babloo. A binder clip slips while they move pages in a narrow admin room.

beats.title: Her different reaction to Naveen
beats.action: Meenakshi notices Naveen's composed response as he restores the file order and thanks him. The interaction contrasts Babloo's spontaneous physical rescue with Naveen's quiet precision.
beats.reaction: The effect is interest in a different side of a known colleague, not a generalized right to touch.

scenes.title: Midday work, Naveen B voluntary demonstration

beats.title: Rounds and team duties
beats.action: Clinical rounds and paperwork. Meenakshi briefly thinks of the unresolved morning glimpse but does not spend hours daydreaming or miss patient care.

beats.title: A chosen professional demonstration
beats.action: At a legitimate wellness-camp volunteer orientation, Meenakshi offers to demonstrate safe hand/wrist support using Naveen only after he agrees. This is his administrative volunteer duty, not medical treatment.
beats.physical: A short guided grip then release; mutually accepted and context-specific.
beats.reaction: She is surprised by how smoothly he handles the attention; he responds sincerely rather than becoming a duplicate of Babloo.

beats.action: At the supplier they discover a batch/label mismatch. Aditi checks procurement, Yash spots a discrepancy, Avi handles the contact. Meenakshi directs the correction. This is a new work challenge with psychological follow-through instead of another staged fall/waist rescue.

beats.action: They finish vendor duties, separate at suitable pickup points if appropriate, and Meenakshi returns to society. No invented kiss, repeated jealousy complaint or second intimate road trip.

scenes.title: Home transition and her own decision

beats.title: Family responsibility first
beats.action: Meenakshi checks Vihaan's care and normal home routine. Nikhil's evening arrival, Mohan's location, and Dev/Ishita whereabouts are tracked but not invented as witnesses.

beats.title: From a wardrobe accident to a deliberate choice
beats.action: After changing out of her clinical white coat into a comfortable off-duty outfit, Meenakshi remembers Babloo's startled silence. She makes an intentional decision not to hide behind her work identity or dupatta during the upcoming car-document handover; the exact visual styling is for author review.
beats.reaction: This is her private decision. Babloo cannot know her motives until she says or shows them.

scenes.title: Society Babloo B — first deliberate show and gratitude

beats.title: A grounded return reason
beats.action: Babloo brings the mechanic's completed car-status note and repair receipt/keys for signature, as discussed earlier. If the car was not repaired, he instead brings the actual inspection estimate. He does not arrive with missing noodles, a repeated lost packet, or unearned access to her bedroom.

beats.title: First chosen presentation after the accident
beats.action: Meenakshi meets Babloo in an ordinary but personally chosen off-duty look, without immediately covering herself with the dupatta. Unlike the morning, she knowingly lets him observe her appearance and asks with dry, teasing confidence why he was so quiet after the hatch mishap.
beats.physical: Voluntary, clothed first deliberate presentation. No graphic anatomy, forced touching or previously unapproved nudity.
beats.reaction: Babloo is clearly flustered; Meenakshi notices his reaction but still does not gain omniscient certainty about what he saw at 07:40.

beats.title: The response and a voluntary thank-you
beats.action: Babloo answers carefully that he was surprised by the mishap. Meenakshi can choose the already-proposed brief thank-you hug for his car help after he agrees; they separate naturally.
beats.physical: Optional brief, mutually welcomed, fully clothed gratitude hug; if the author chooses a different first-show execution, keep the hug separate and optional.
beats.reaction: She feels the difference between a morning reflex and an evening choice. Babloo takes the warmth seriously, not as guaranteed permission later.

beats.title: A real ending, not a promise
beats.action: Babloo departs with his operational task complete. Meenakshi closes the door and privately thinks about why she wanted his reaction; this remains a question rather than an immediate affair or guaranteed next scene.

scenes.title: Evening close and protected family track

beats.title: A working mother returns to the household

Nikhil's return can be slotted after his work schedule is confirmed; Mohan's one-sided private plot must not be falsely treated as Meenakshi's knowledge.
